principles: Quality and correctness are constraints; cost is optimized only among candidates that pass them.
A failure to detect a difference is not evidence of equivalence.
Discovery results select candidates but cannot promote them.
Every comparison is bound to model scale, tokens, data, hardware, precision, runtime, context, and load.
The cheapest point on a quality-non-inferior Pareto frontier wins.
Negative and inconclusive results remain in the evidence matrix.

language_loss.estimand: mean paired candidate-minus-control validation loss in natural-log nats
language_loss.decision_rule: upper one-sided paired 95% confidence bound must be at or below the margin
language_loss.historical_noise_use: the 0.00965-nat seed range is a variance-planning input, never an equivalence rule

bounded_task_scores.decision_rule: lower paired 95% confidence bound must be at or above the negative margin and every declared absolute floor must pass
bounded_task_scores.paired_resampling: example-level paired bootstrap with 10000 deterministic resamples

systems.decision_rule: the lower paired 95% confidence bound must clear the applicable improvement threshold

multiplicity.confirmation_candidates: freeze candidates before confirmation and apply Holm correction across candidates sharing one control
multiplicity.must_pass_endpoints: quality and systems gates form an intersection-union decision; every endpoint must pass

statistical_contract.missing_data: a failed, interrupted, or unevaluable run cannot be silently replaced; retain it and execute the preregistered replacement rule
statistical_contract.precision: report effect sizes and confidence bounds; p-values alone are insufficient

requirements: retention of all attempted arms and hyperparameters
candidate and control paired within each run
quality and claimed systems gates pass
crossed design with three initialization seeds and two packed-data orders
at least 10 training tokens per parameter unless a preregistered scaling-law analysis selects a longer horizon
quality and claimed systems gates pass
three paired seeds with distinct data orders
no sign reversal in the primary effect
one matched target-scale pair only after medium-scale promotion
treat as a reversal and integration check rather than population-level equivalence evidence

forbidden_shortcuts: analytic FLOP or state savings without realized measurements
allocation length presented as effective context
synthetic retrieval presented as general long-context reasoning
promotion from an adapted checkpoint when the claim is from-scratch architecture quality
promotion_gate.decision: promote only when every required gate is true; otherwise retain as research-only, reject, or declare inconclusive

change_control.rule: any threshold, task, sample count, or decision-rule change creates a new policy version
allowed_without_version_change: updating evidence status after a preregistered decision
